subject: How a record shows it is sourced
decision: No extra regalia for records. Web-sourced records stay exactly as the existing records/claude-code files: short, sharp, a simple one-line Source statement at the top. Locally sourced records carry a one-line stamp of approval at the top indicating they have been adequately sourced. No number-based reference lists in the header, no direct source quotes mixed into the prose, no separate stamp ledger. Clarified the same session: "every claim has a source" does not mean the source has to be explicitly named inline. The sourcing requirement stands; only its display moves from the prose to the one header line.
